step1_analysis.description: A CMOS double-balanced mixer core (Gilbert cell) used for down-conversion in an RF receiver. It mixes an RF signal with an LO signal to produce an IF signal.

paper_reference.title: A 2-GHz CMOS Image-Reject Receiver With LMS Calibration

Gain.description: Conversion gain from RF input to IF output

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Vth=0.42V, Vov=0.28V, Id=105uA -> g_m1 = 750uS. With R_L = 1k, CG = (2/pi) * g_m1 * R_L = 0.477 V/V = -6.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 57 dB for the entire receiver chain (LNA + Mixer + IF amps). The extracted netlist is only the passive-loaded mixer core, which typically has a small loss or near 0 dB gain.

Output_power.description: Power of the IF signal delivered to the load

sky130_expected.calculation: V_if_amp = 4.77 mV. P_out = V_if_amp^2 / 4000 = 5.68 nW = -52.4 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output power depends on the input test signal amplitude (10mV used here). The paper's 17 dBm refers to IIP3, not standard operating output power.

Power_consumption.description: DC power consumed from the supply

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 50 mW is for the full receiver. The isolated mixer core consumes much less power.

sky130_expected.calculation: Set by testbench source to 2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's target band (2 GHz receiver).
Determined by the chosen RF and LO frequencies in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure conversion gain, power consumption, and operating frequencies of the mixer core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 2-GHz CMOS Image-Reject Receiver Mixer Core
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
RL1 VOUT_P VDD 1k
RL2 VOUT_N VDD 1k

XM1 N1 VIN_P GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 VIN_N GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT_P VLO_P N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT_N VLO_N N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUT_P VLO_P N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VOUT_N VLO_N N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Buffers to prevent filter loading
E1 VOUT_P_BUF 0 VOUT_P 0 1
E2 VOUT_N_BUF 0 VOUT_N 0 1

* 2-stage RC Low-pass filters (fc ~ 160MHz) to extract IF
R_f1a VOUT_P_BUF VOUT_P_F1 1k
C_f1a VOUT_P_F1 0 300f
R_f1b VOUT_P_F1 VOUT_P_F 1k
C_f1b VOUT_P_F 0 300f

R_f2a VOUT_N_BUF VOUT_N_F1 1k
C_f2a VOUT_N_F1 0 300f
R_f2b VOUT_N_F1 VOUT_N_F 1k
C_f2b VOUT_N_F 0 300f

* Difference signal for measurement
B1 VOUT_DIFF 0 V = V(VOUT_P_F) - V(VOUT_N_F)

* Sources (RF=2GHz, LO=1.81GHz -> IF=190MHz)
VVIN_P VIN_P 0 DC 0.7 SIN(0.7 0.01 2G 0 0)
VVIN_N VIN_N 0 DC 0.7
VVLO_P VLO_P 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.5 1.81G 0 0)
VVLO_N VLO_N 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.5 1.81G 0 180)

.control
tran 10p 50n

* 1. Power Consumption
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran Power_consumption avg power from=30n to=50n

* 2. IF Frequency
meas tran t1 WHEN v(VOUT_DIFF)=0 RISE=1 FROM=30n
meas tran t2 WHEN v(VOUT_DIFF)=0 RISE=2 FROM=30n
let IF_Frequency = 1 / (t2 - t1)

* 3. Operating Frequency (RF)
meas tran trf1 WHEN v(VIN_P)=0.7 RISE=1 FROM=30n
meas tran trf2 WHEN v(VIN_P)=0.7 RISE=2 FROM=30n
let Operating_frequency = 1 / (trf2 - trf1)

* 4. Gain (Conversion Gain)
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT_DIFF) from=30n to=50n
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT_DIFF) from=30n to=50n
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
* Attenuation factor of the 2-stage RC filter at 190MHz is 0.723
let v_if_pp_actual = vout_pp / 0.723
let v_if_amp = v_if_pp_actual / 2
let Gain = 20 * log10(v_if_amp / 0.01)

* 5. Output Power (dBm)
* Differential load is 2k (1k + 1k)
let p_out_w = (v_if_amp * v_if_amp) / 4000
let Output_power = 10 * log10(p_out_w / 1e-3)

print Power_consumption
print IF_Frequency
print Operating_frequency
print Gain
print Output_power
quit
.endc
